hints.tr: Sıra fark etmez: `{` ve `}` birbirini etkilemez.
hints.en: The order does not matter: `{` and `}` do not affect each other.

hints.tr:
Çözümün tamamı:

```python
def escape_braces(text):
    return text.replace("{", "{{").replace("}", "}}")


example = escape_braces('{"category": "<name>"}')
template = "Answer as JSON: " + example + "\nMessage: {message}"
print(template.format(message="Hi"))
```
hints.en:
The full solution:

```python
def escape_braces(text):
    return text.replace("{", "{{").replace("}", "}}")


example = escape_braces('{"category": "<name>"}')
template = "Answer as JSON: " + example + "\nMessage: {message}"
print(template.format(message="Hi"))
```
